name: spaces
description: Space scaffold — the thin per-space frontend the Tauri webview loads for `--app=<id>` windows. NO hub code (no marketplace/settings/auth/studio): just the SUI runtime + deck-host confinement + a loader that reads __SHIP_APP_ID__ and mounts the space's surface. Built by `deck build` (deck-cli) into .deck/space-scaffold.
